newsitem.title: UK: UK CBI November monthly trends survey -- table.
newsitem.headline: UK CBI November monthly trends survey -- table.

text.p: Tabulated results from November monthly survey of trends in UK manufacturing by Confederation of British Industry (CBI):
CBI MONTHLY TRENDS ENQUIRY (a) NOV OCT SEPT AUGUST
NOTES - * over the coming four months;

The survey was conducted between October 22 and November 13, 1996. 1,095 manufacturing companies responded, representing 50 industries and accounting for about half of the UK's manufactured exports and output of some two million employees;
- (a) in percent, giving balance between those replying "up', "above normal' or "more than adequate,' and those replying "down', "below normal" or "less than adequate."
